### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/service-analytics`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **7** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/README.md`, `packages/spec/liveness/analytics_cube.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/analytics_cube.md`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

**1** hand-written doc(s) NAME something this change touched and may need an implementation-accuracy re-verification:

- `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx`  _(via MetricSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_

⛔ **2** release-owned page(s) also name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-2.mdx`  _(via MetricSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-5.mdx`  _(via AnalyticsService (symbol, a top-level class))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/liveness/README.md`, `packages/spec/liveness/analytics_cube.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/analytics_cube.md`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **3** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **137** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f927864ea056f79d04ad8d62f1a7c13afed31d07` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `122fa8ae7cc7c7eddf25f38e3633274316e5cae9` — the merge of head `25bd1e1321ee52095eecfafb7c021a71b844e2a9` into base `f927864ea056f79d04ad8d62f1a7c13afed31d07`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 122fa8ae7cc7c7eddf25f38e3633274316e5cae9 && git checkout 122fa8ae7cc7c7eddf25f38e3633274316e5cae9
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin f927864ea056f79d04ad8d62f1a7c13afed31d07 25bd1e1321ee52095eecfafb7c021a71b844e2a9 && git checkout -B drift-repro f927864ea056f79d04ad8d62f1a7c13afed31d07 && git merge --no-ff 25bd1e1321ee52095eecfafb7c021a71b844e2a9

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json f927864ea056f79d04ad8d62f1a7c13afed31d07
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs f927864ea056f79d04ad8d62f1a7c13afed31d07` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `25bd1e1321ee52095eecfafb7c021a71b844e2a9`
Local-runs: none

Inputs read: card #20282 (body and all 31 comments, the stage-3 report `5901282387` and ruling `5901302748` included), PR #20736 (body, 14-file list, net diff `origin/main...25bd1e1321`, whose two-dot diff from the merge-base `d2820876f7` is the same 14 files at +295/−41, so the merge of main dropped nothing), the tree at the head by `git show` / `git grep`, the objectui formatter at the pin `.objectui-sha` = `dd3f7e1be3` (unchanged by this PR), and the check-runs on the head, read last.

### ① Derived judgments

**Accept-set and public-surface changes the diff implies — each judged:**

1. `CubeMeta` (`packages/spec/src/contracts/analytics-service.ts`) gains optional `description` on the cube, optional `description` and `format` on each measure, optional `description` on each dimension. Additive; nothing removed, renamed or re-typed. **Right.** `packages/spec/api-surface/contracts.json` records the export as `"CubeMeta (interface)"` by name only, so no surface artifact was owed a regeneration; `Type Check · source gates` is green.
2. `AnalyticsMetadataResponseSchema` (`packages/spec/src/api/analytics.zod.ts`) gains cube `description`, member `description`, and a measure shape `cubeMetaMeasureShape` = member shape + `format`. Bound to `CubeMeta` at compile time by `CubeMetaMatchesContract` (`api/analytics.test.ts:31`). Additive; a dimension `format` is still stripped (pinned). **Right.**
3. `AnalyticsService.getMeta` (`service-analytics/src/analytics-service.ts:2319`) copies `description` / `format` with conditional spreads when the registered definition declares them and spreads nothing otherwise; the `.filter(isCubePublic)` from stage 1 stays. Reaches the wire verbatim: `packages/runtime/src/domains/analytics.ts:136-137` hands the array to `deps.success(result)`. **Right.**
4. `MetricSchema.format` describe and TSDoc (`data/analytics.zod.ts`): text only, no accept-set change; the generated `content/docs/references/data/analytics.mdx` carries the new describe in both tables. **Right.**
5. Showcase `done_rate.format`: `'percent'` to `'0.0%'`. Example only. At the pin, `packages/core/src/utils/dataset-format.ts#formatMeasure` reads `format.includes('%')` as percent and counts the `0`s after the dot as decimals (one); `'percent'` had no `%` and no dot, so it rendered a bare integer. **Right.**
6. Liveness: `analytics_cube.description`, `measures.description`, `dimensions.description` dead to live. Evidence `analytics-service.ts#getMeta` resolves; producer `packages/cli/src/commands/serve.ts#CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS` resolves (`configKey: 'analyticsCubes'` at :1876, the quoted line at :4647) and `analytics-service.ts#registerAll` at :1102. Walking the ledger at the head: the 3 dead rows are exactly `measures.name`, `dimensions.name`, `refreshKey` (tombstones); the shard moves 20/6 to 23/3 on 26 classified, a delta equal to the three flipped rows; `Spec property liveness` is green, which is the verdict on the absolute count. **Right.**
7. `driver-memory`'s `MemoryAnalyticsService#getMeta` (`memory-analytics.ts:1365`) untouched: projects name/title/type only. The contract declares the members optional, and no in-repo composition registers it as the analytics service (git grep finds only comments outside `driver-memory`). **Right, and the ledger note says so.**
8. Changeset: `@objectstack/spec` minor, `@objectstack/service-analytics` minor; both publish (`./contracts` is an export of spec; service-analytics is not private). **Right** (see ②).

**Author-shown and AI-facing texts — each sentence tested against the tree:**

- Changeset (`.changeset/20282-analytics-cube-meta-descriptions.md`): "now publishes … when the cube definition declares them" TRUE. "`CubeMeta` (`@objectstack/spec/contracts`) gains …; `AnalyticsMetadataResponseSchema` declares the same members; a definition that declares none of them is published exactly as before" TRUE (conditional spreads; pinned by "publishes no key a definition does not declare"). "`getMeta` copies what the definition declares and fills in nothing. A cube compiled from a dataset carries each dataset measure's `format` and no `description`" TRUE: `dataset-compiler.ts:679` copies `m.format`; nothing copies a description — the dataset's own `description` is an `I18nLabelSchema` (`ui/dataset.zod.ts:337`) never copied, and dataset members refuse `description` with guidance (`dataset.zod.ts:112-113`, `:179-180`). "The liveness ledger rows … move from dead to live" TRUE. "This supersedes one sentence of this release's note …: it says `GET /api/v1/analytics/meta` is unchanged and keeps `name`, `type` and `title`" TRUE: `.changeset/20282-analytics-cube-format-granularities-enforced.md:16` carries that sentence, present on `origin/main` and byte-identical at the head. Moment of truth: true on `main` when this PR lands, provided no release consumes the stage-2 note between now and then; after such a release the phrase "this release's note" would read as an earlier release's — a timing caveat, not a falsity now. "A client that formats a result column still reads `format` off the query result's `fields[]`" TRUE (`api/analytics.zod.ts:109-110`, `data-api.mdx`).
- PR body: "Stage 3: `CubeMeta` and `GET /analytics/meta` carry … projected by `service-analytics#getMeta`. The three `description` liveness rows move to `live`, and the showcase `done_rate` format becomes `'0.0%'`" TRUE. `Clause-②: yes (widening)` stands alone on its own line; `Part of #20282` is line 1 (`Part-of PR must not also close its card` green).
- `content/docs/api/data-api.mdx` callout: "publishes a deliberately narrow projection of it — `name`, `type`, `title` (the definition's `label`), `description`, and on a measure its declared `format`; never `sql` or `granularities`" TRUE and exhaustive: `MetricSchema`'s value keys are `label`, `description`, `type`, `sql`, `format` (plus the retired `name` tombstone); `DimensionSchema`'s are `label`, `description`, `type`, `sql`, `granularities` (plus the tombstone). "`currency` and `percentScale` are not reachable through the metadata endpoint at all" TRUE (`CubeMeta` has neither). The unchanged `GET /analytics/meta` section below it enumerates no members, so nothing there went stale; `client-sdk.mdx:321-325` likewise.
- `api/analytics.zod.ts` docblock: "`description` carries the definition's `description`, and a measure also carries its definition's `format` (#20282, the additive return path the #6442 ruling recorded below); each is absent when the definition declares none" TRUE — the Meta Response docblock records "Return path if more keys are ever needed (recorded with the ruling): add the key to the projection above — additive and backwards compatible". "`sql` and `granularities` are dropped by the projection and are NOT reachable through this endpoint" TRUE and exhaustive (key lists above). "This is the dimension member; `cubeMetaMeasureShape` adds `format`" TRUE. The four new describes ("projected from the definition's `description`", "projected from the measure definition's `format`", "Cube description, projected from …", "its title and description") TRUE.
- `contracts/analytics-service.ts` docblock: "copied from the cube definition when it declares them and absent when it does not; `AnalyticsMetadataResponseSchema` declares the same shape and `api/analytics.test.ts` binds the two at compile time" TRUE.
- `data/analytics.zod.ts` `MetricSchema.format` TSDoc "The `GET /analytics/meta` projection publishes it on the measure too" and describe "…and on the measure by GET /analytics/meta" TRUE at this head; the generated mdx matches.
- `analytics-service.ts` docblocks: `withDeclaredMeasureFormats` ("`GET /analytics/meta` publishes the same declared value per measure (`getMeta`), with no column to attach it to") TRUE; `getMeta` (copied when declared, never filled in; a compiled dataset's cube carries the compiler's `format` and no `description`) TRUE.
- Showcase comment: "A numeral pattern, the vocabulary `fields[].format` documents: `%` marks a percent, `.0` one decimal. The value above is in percentage points (0-100)" TRUE: the `fields[].format` describe cites `"0.0%"`; the SQL multiplies by `100.0`; the pinned formatter reads `%` and the one decimal as stated. It does not claim anything about the formatter's magnitude heuristic (flag 5 in ③).
- New test docblock and comments: "`getMeta()`, which `GET /api/v1/analytics/meta` hands to `success()` verbatim" TRUE (`runtime/src/domains/analytics.ts:136-137`); "the projection carried `{ name, type, title }` per member and `{ name, title }` per cube" TRUE of the base; "the dataset's own `description` is not copied … and a dataset measure or dimension has no `description` key" TRUE. Spec test comment "a key the object schema did not declare would be stripped by this parse, not kept" TRUE for `z.object` (the dimension-`format` assertion pins it; Test Core green).
- Ledger rows: the three evidence / producer / note texts TRUE per items 6-7 above; `measures.description` note ("the dataset schema refuses it and points to the dataset's own `description`") TRUE (`dataset.zod.ts:179-180`); `dimensions.description` note TRUE (`:112-113`); `measures.format` note ("Also on discovery since 2026-09-29 … the additive return path the narrowing recorded on `AnalyticsMetadataResponseSchema`, #6442, names; `data-api.mdx` still sends a client that formats amounts to `fields[]`") TRUE; `_note` ("and so are the three `description` annotations …, while the retired caching block is not") TRUE (`refreshKey` is the dead tombstone row).
- README row: "The 3 `dead` are the `refreshKey` tombstone and the inner `name` on each of `measures`/`dimensions`" TRUE (ledger walk); "It was 6 until #20282's third stage … `analytics-service#getMeta` copies each onto its `CubeMeta` entry, the read point the `title`/`label` rows already cite" TRUE.
- Nothing false, unsourced or over-broad found. A tree-wide sweep at the head for the falsified phrasings ("not published by GET /analytics/meta", "format is not reachable", "name, type and title", "/meta is unchanged") hits only the superseded stage-2 changeset (ruled: report, not edit) and the new test's past-tense docblock.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset: `'@objectstack/spec': minor`, `'@objectstack/service-analytics': minor` — the two packages whose published surface moves (a widened exported interface and response schema; a widened served projection). `examples/app-showcase` is not a released package. No `skip-changeset` label, correctly.
- Clause-②: yes (widening) — declared identically in the changeset and the PR body, standalone; matches the diff: every new member is optional, nothing is removed, renamed or re-typed, undeclared keys strip as before, and the stage-1 visibility filter is unchanged. No narrowing arm is owed; no BREAKING sentence and no ADR-0087 marker are owed (`Check Changeset` green; the report's `check:adr-0087-registration` reads "adds no declared-breaking changeset").
- AGENTS.md: `yes` takes at least `minor` — `minor` on both is right. Not governed (no path on the Prime Directive #14 governed-surface register — `docs/adr/**`, the north-star doc, `skills/**`, the two agent instruction files, the agent config tree; `Governed Surface Queue Guard` green).

### ③ Boundary flags

Dev deviations (report `5901282387`):
1. File-surface amendments (`data/analytics.zod.ts` describe + TSDoc; `data-api.mdx` callout) — **answered**: ruling `5901302748` accepts them; verified both texts were falsified by the widening and are now true.
2. Stage-2 changeset edited in place, refused by `check:empty-changeset`, restored — **answered** (Q1 = A): verified the file is byte-identical to `origin/main` at the head and the supersession sentence lives in this PR's own changeset. Timing caveat recorded in ①.
3. `format` on `/meta` beyond seat 2's Q3 — **answered** (Q2 = A): additive, the #6442-recorded return path; verified 0 consumers of `/analytics/meta`, `analytics.meta` or `CubeMeta` in objectui at the pin, with the query door as the lit control, so nothing in the pinned sibling moves.
4. Plain `git merge` of `origin/main` (no os-regen) — **answered by measurement**: the two-dot and three-dot diffs are the same 14 files at +295/−41, so main's side (including #20729's other-line edits to `analytics-service.ts`) is intact; every gate on the merge head is green.
5. Commit trailers — **answered**: all four commits carry the AGENTS.md model-free trailer pair; none carries a model identifier.
6. Cleanup of the worktree — not verifiable from GitHub; not a PR fact.

Open questions: Q1 (where the stage-2 correction lives) ruled A; Q2 (keep measure `format` on `/meta`) ruled A — both **answered** in `5901302748`.

Out-of-scope findings (four, none filed) — each judged:
- Compiled dataset publishes no `description` on `/meta` — true (compiler copies none; the value is an `I18nLabel`); routed to the picker sub-issue. **Answered.**
- `percentScale` heuristic: `MetricSchema` has no `percentScale` key (verified key list), so a `done_rate` value strictly between 0 and 1 (under one percent done) is multiplied by 100 by `percentDisplayValue` in the pinned formatter. The showcase comment does not claim otherwise. Recorded with no carrier. **Answered.**
- `driver-memory`'s narrower `getMeta` — true, contract-permitted, not a door. **Answered.**
- `check:platform-checklist` local red on inputs identical to `main` — not this PR's; no check-run on the head is red. **Answered.**

Escalated to the seat (not blocking this verdict):
- **PR body discrepancy.** The stored body is 461 characters: the three content lines plus the harness emoji footer line and a bare session URL. The dev report says the body was read back byte-identical at 7193 characters and that its footer is the AGENTS.md session-URL form; neither holds against GitHub as read. The lines the gates read (`Part of #20282` first, `Clause-②: yes (widening)` standalone) are intact and every body-reading check-run is green, so the diff's verdict is unaffected. The timeline exposes no body-edit event (GitHub emits none); `updated_at` 23:56:06Z coincides with the seat's label add. Per AGENTS.md, establish the actor before any body write, and never re-send a body that already carries an appended footer.
- **objectui picker sub-issue** still unfiled — the claim `5900176831` makes it the seat's act once the served shape passes review; the card's lane names it. This record is that review.
- **Console Pin Gate** is a roster skip on this head; the objectui census above is why the widening cannot break the pinned sibling.

Check-runs on `25bd1e1321` (46 raw, 35 deduped by name keeping the newest `started_at`): all `completed`; 31 `success`; 4 `skipped` (Auto Label, Check PR Size, Console Pin Gate, Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)); 0 failed; none still running. Green among them: Lint & Repo Gates, Spec property liveness, TypeScript Type Check and its four Type Check legs, Build Core, Build Docs, Test Core and its six shards, Check Changeset, Governed Surface Queue Guard, the three card-relation checks, Dogfood Regression Gate (three shards), Dogfood Verify CLI, Temporal Conformance, Check Documentation Links, Flag docs affected by code changes.

Reviewed-by: `session_01Sfe5YjBLwB9J3y8fvm2xq1`

**VERDICT: PASS**

Adopted and posted by `domain:spec` seat 5 (`session_01Sfe5YjBLwB9J3y8fvm2xq1`) · 2026-09-30T00:24Z · rendered by the seat's at-tier review subagent on this head. The seat read its served tier family from the subagent transcript before posting.
- ③ 1, the PR body: the stored body is the seat's own. It was rewritten short through the relay's `issue_patch` before the review, as `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` gives the body to the seat. The dev's 7193-character figure was the draft it opened. The gate-read lines are the seat's.
- ③ 2, the objectui picker sub-issue: the seat files it when this stage lands, because the served shape is now reviewed.
